Emoji Sentences

Read the sentence. Say the adjective for the emoji.

 

Sentence 1

My dad was because someone hit his car in the parking lot.

 

Sentence 1

My dad was angry because someone hit his car in the parking lot.

Similar word: mad

 

Sentence 2

Our kitchen is very . Only one person can cook in it.

 

Sentence 2

Our kitchen is very small. Only one person can cook in it.

Similar word: little

 

Sentence 3

The new train is very . It gets to the city in ten minutes.

 

Sentence 3

The new train is very fast. It gets to the city in ten minutes.

Similar word: quick

 

Sentence 4

I heard a noise outside my window last night.

 

Sentence 4

I heard a strange noise outside my window last night.

Similar word: weird

 

Sentence 5

I am so to see you again!

 

Sentence 5

I am so happy to see you again!

Similar word: glad
